data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): apply() dispatch order must be (1) validate action in _LEAVES keys → else UnknownActionError, (2) validate direction match → else DirectionMismatchError, (3) invoke leaf body. Add test that asserts every _LEAVES entry is either fully implemented OR explicitly marked @pending in a registry; CI fails if any leaf still raises NotImplementedError at story-branch merge time (catches incomplete atomic merge). Rationale: prevents NotImplementedError leaking past the UnknownActionError contract during partial atomic merge (implicit_assumption).
